evidence.source: 孟繁杰、李焱，《从满汉合璧文献看语气词“啊、吧、吗、呢”的出现时间》, 古汉语研究 2022年第3期
evidence.field: pp.27–29; review of particle analyses and dated spellings
evidence.text: The authors summarize competing accounts of sentence-final 罢, including ellipsis from 便罢/也罢 and development from predicative 罢. They question whether a cited Yuan example is still verbal, note doubts about proposed Ming 吧 examples from 型世言, and report four particle 吧 occurrences in 1766 清语易言 as the earliest verifiable example in their survey. These are secondary reports about particle spellings and uses, not the formation date of graph 吧.
evidence.title: 从满汉合璧文献看语气词啊、吧、吗、呢的出现时间

evidence.source: University of Venice hosted IACL paper
evidence.text: The paper distinguishes imperative 吧1 from conjectural/assertive 吧2. It reports 吧2 by the mid-eighteenth century, citing 1730 and 1740 sources written with 罢; says 吧 spelling appeared in the eighteenth century and became fixed from the late Qing; and argues 吧2 developed through contraction of sentence-final 不是 while 吧1 derives from 罢. The author treats their later written conflation as having no semantic-development relation. This is an attributed hypothesis, not an established universal derivation.
evidence.title: Microsoft Word — BoAs IACL_draft1.docx (PDF)

evidence.field: 《說文》, 《廣韻》 and 形義通解 for 巴
evidence.text: The entry transmits the received Shuowen account that 巴 is 蟲 and the alternative that it is an elephant-eating snake; it labels displayed forms as oracle-bone, small-seal and other categories, and lists 巴’s 伯加 fanqie with Middle Chinese 幫 initial, level tone, 麻 rhyme, open division II. Its later glosses include waiting/hope and approach, but do not demonstrate a semantic chain. The classifications and received account do not settle the identity or chronology of ancient forms.
